mechanism_narrative: A low federal funds rate (below 0.2%) signals an accommodative monetary policy environment that reduces discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 0.2%.

mechanism_narrative: High unemployment (UNRATE above 8.0%) signals a deteriorating labor market and economic weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE > 8.0.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST) and real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) signals a broad-based weakening in consumer demand, which reduces corporate revenue expectations and produces negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when both HOUST and RSAFS are below their 12-month moving averages.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion, a decline in industrial production (INDPRO below 95.0) signals an impending economic slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when the economy is in a late-cycle expansion and INDPRO < 95.0.

mechanism_narrative: A high CPI index (above 220.0) signals persistent inflationary pressures that may prompt Federal Reserve tightening, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL > 220.0.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained upward trend in payroll employment (PAYEMS) signals a strengthening labor market that supports consumer spending and corporate earnings, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when PAYEMS is above its 12-month moving average.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in housing starts (HOUST below 550.0) signals weak consumer demand for housing, which may indicate a broader economic slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when HOUST < 550.0.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) and inflation (CPIAUCSL) signals a tightening monetary policy cycle that increases discount rates for equity valuation, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS rises and CPIAUCSL rises.
